meta.purpose: Locked observed evidence for the genotype-nonlinearity validation. Never refit.
meta.halt_reason: Data-availability gate (spec §4.1) FAILED for both clean-primaries: no citable >=2-dose genotype-stratified exposure grid exists. Phenytoin — per-genotype Michaelis-Menten Vmax is paywalled (Mamiya 1998, PMID 9860067; abstract gives only Vmax(*1/*3)~=0.58*Vmax(*1/*1)); the *3/*3 activity fraction was not found in any accessible source. Propafenone — clean EM/PM cross exists only at a single 300 mg dose (Tran 2022, PMC9324789); the within-EM dose-nonlinearity is documented (Siddoway 1987, PMID 2434237) but not stratified at >=2 genotype-crossed doses. The full genotype cross-term (P2) is NOT validatable on citable human data. Per the correctness-over-benchmark / no-cherry-picking discipline, the *3/*3 fraction was NOT invented. See data-independent arm-sign mechanism result + the propafenone EM P1 check below.

observed.statement: ~10-fold rise in steady-state concentration as dose increased 3-fold (300->900 mg/day) in EXTENSIVE metabolizers — saturable first-pass.

available_evidence.p1_role: The engine (axial saturable, EM) should reproduce a supra-proportional beta_EM>1 (ideally near 2.1); the linear-null gives beta=1.0. This is the one citable clinical saturation signature.

available_evidence.note: Recorded as CONTEXT only. The 11.2x fold EXCEEDS the linear-null 1/(1-fm)=5x, so saturation predicts a SMALLER fold — this is the base genotype + bioavailability + t1/2 effect, NOT a saturation-validation point (same trap as voriconazole). NOT scored as a saturation signal.

negative_controls_note: Clinical negative-control scoring (tolbutamide hard-null, metoprolol mild-positive) also requires genotype-stratified dose data not curated here; the engine-side non-engagement is instead demonstrated synthetically in the arm-sign mechanism tests (high-Km synthetic gene -> beta~=1).
data_independent_result_pointer: The primary deliverable under this scope is the data-independent arm-sign mechanism demonstration (tests/integration/test_pgx_arm_sign_mechanism.py): the engine produces delta_beta>0 (systemic divergence) and delta_beta<0 (first-pass convergence) from topology+MM with realistic PM scaling — no clinical data, no fitting.
